draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar, with a median latency of 41 vs 118 ms per utterance.
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling's median latency was 41 ms per utterance (measured on Corvex A2, fp16) versus Talmar's 118 ms (reported by Ruiz-Hale et al., 2023, on Corvex A1, fp32), though the two were measured under different hardware and precision conditions.
rationale: Numbers match T1.r1.lat (41) and T1.r2.lat (118). However, the two latencies were measured on different accelerators and precisions (A2/fp16 vs A1/fp32), so a direct "decodes faster" comparison is not cleanly supported. The claim should note the differing measurement conditions.
